Fort Bend County is Houston's master-planned-community heartland, anchored by Sugar Land with the county seat at Richmond. One of the most diverse counties in America, it grows through large MPCs — Sienna, Aliana, Harvest Green — along the Grand Parkway, where MUD boundaries and levee-protected floodplain determine both taxes and insurability.
Source: U.S. Census Bureau · Data verified: August 21, 2026
